description: Revocation staleness (T9). `constants`; `max_age` (per-class window from a policy); `effective_reversibility` (stricter of server and signed class; missing or unknown = irreversible); `age` (checkRevocationAge); `epoch` (signed guardian epoch, Ed25519, check with an optional verifier-side cap; `alg` of an unregistered suite must be refused); `gate` (the whole decision for a signed epoch / a bare root / nothing under a policy and a class: `mode` epoch|root|none, `root_issued_at: null` = unknown age). Strings "NaN" stand for a NaN number (those cases carry `ok_only`: compare `ok` only, a NaN has no portable text). Reasons compared exactly. `revocation_set` is the sorted set (UTF-8 byte order, root bound to the size) the next two tables use; `membership` (verifyNonMembership: root, id, proof -> ok; `set` names which set the root is: main, one, empty or the wrong one); `gate_ids` (the whole checker with a signed epoch over the main set, issued `epoch_issued_at`, `ids` to prove, `proofs` keyed by id (absent = none supplied), compared on ok and reason exactly).
